name: STACKIT Object Storage Outbound Connector
description: Reads and writes objects in STACKIT Object Storage, the S3-compatible object store of the STACKIT sovereign cloud. Uploads and downloads Camunda documents, copies, deletes, lists and inspects objects, and creates presigned URLs.

properties.label: Access key ID
properties.description: The access key ID of a STACKIT Object Storage credentials group. Reference a secret of the connector runtime rather than pasting the value, for example {{secrets.STACKIT_S3_ACCESS_KEY}} or =camunda.secrets.STACKIT_S3_ACCESS_KEY.
properties.tooltip: Created in the STACKIT Portal under Object Storage > Credentials & Groups. By default a credential can read and write every bucket of its project; bucket policies can restrict that.

properties.label: Secret access key
properties.description: The secret access key belonging to the access key ID. STACKIT shows it only once, at creation time, and cannot show it again — store it in a secret of the connector runtime and reference it here, for example {{secrets.STACKIT_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}} or =camunda.secrets.STACKIT_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
properties.tooltip: If the secret was lost, delete the access key in the STACKIT Portal and create a new one; it cannot be recovered.

properties.label: Region
properties.description: The STACKIT region the bucket lives in. A bucket created in eu01 is not reachable through the eu02 endpoint and there is no cross-region redirect.

properties.label: Custom endpoint
properties.description: Optional. Replaces the regional STACKIT endpoint (https://object.storage.<region>.onstackit.cloud) with another S3-compatible endpoint, for example http://localhost:9000 for a local MinIO used in testing, or a new STACKIT region this connector version does not list yet. Leave empty for normal use.
properties.tooltip: The region is still used as the SigV4 signing region even when a custom endpoint is set.

properties.label: Use path-style access
properties.description: Addresses buckets as <endpoint>/<bucket>/<key> instead of <bucket>.<endpoint>/<key>. Enabled by default: STACKIT serves both styles, but the wildcard TLS certificate covers only one host label, so a bucket name containing a dot breaks virtual-hosted-style TLS. Turn it off only if a custom endpoint requires virtual-hosted-style addressing.

properties.label: Operation
properties.description: The STACKIT Object Storage operation this task performs.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the target bucket. Bucket names are globally unique across all STACKIT customers and must already exist — this connector does not create buckets.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: The key the object is stored under, for example 2026/01/invoice.pdf. Leave empty to use the file name of the document; the upload fails if the document has no file name either.

properties.label: Document source
properties.description: The document to upload. Choose a Camunda document from a process variable, supply inline content, or point at an external URL.

properties.value: =if operation.operation_document_documentSource = "camunda" then operation.operation_document_camundaReference else if operation.operation_document_documentSource = "inline" then { "camunda.document.type": "inline", content: operation.operation_document_inline_content, name: operation.operation_document_inline_fileName, contentType: operation.operation_document_inline_contentType } else if operation.operation_document_documentSource = "external" then { "camunda.document.type": "external", url: operation.operation_document_external_url, name: operation.operation_document_external_fileName } else null

properties.label: Content type
properties.description: Overrides the content type of the document, for example application/pdf. Leave empty to keep the content type the document carries.

properties.label: Metadata
properties.description: User metadata stored with the object, as a FEEL context of string values, for example ={"orderId": "4711"}. STACKIT stores these as x-amz-meta-* headers.

properties.label: Tags
properties.description: Object tags, as a FEEL context of string values, for example ={"env": "prod"}. Tags are stored with the object and can be used for lifecycle rules.

properties.label: Server-side encryption
properties.description: Requests SSE-S3 (AES256), where STACKIT manages the encryption key. STACKIT supports SSE-S3 and SSE-C only; there is no SSE-KMS, so no key ARN can be supplied. Leave off to store the object unencrypted at the object level.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the object is read from.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: Key of the object to download, for example 2026/01/invoice.pdf.

properties.label: Version ID
properties.description: Downloads a specific version of the object. Leave empty for the current version; only meaningful on a bucket with versioning enabled.

properties.label: Response format
properties.description: How the downloaded bytes are returned. 'Document reference' uploads them to the Camunda document store and returns a reference, which is the only safe choice for large objects; text and JSON are returned inline and are limited by the maximum variable size.

properties.label: Encoding
properties.description: Character set used to decode the response. Default UTF-8.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the object is deleted from.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: Key of the object to delete.

properties.label: Version ID
properties.description: Permanently deletes one specific version instead of writing a delete marker. Leave empty for the usual delete.

properties.label: Source bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the object is copied from.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Source key
properties.description: Key of the object to copy.

properties.label: Source version ID
properties.description: Copies one specific version of the source object. Leave empty for the current version.

properties.label: Destination bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the copy is written to. May be the same as the source bucket.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Destination key
properties.description: Key the copy is written to.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket to list.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Prefix
properties.description: Returns only keys that start with this prefix, for example 2026/01/. Leave empty to list the whole bucket.

properties.label: Delimiter
properties.description: Collapses every key that shares a prefix up to this character into a single entry of commonPrefixes, which is how a folder listing is emulated. Use / for folder-like behaviour.

properties.label: Max keys
properties.description: Maximum number of keys returned in one page, between 1 and 1000. STACKIT caps a page at 1000 keys regardless of a higher value.

properties.label: Continuation token
properties.description: Continues a previous listing. Pass the nextContinuationToken of the previous result here, and loop while truncated is true.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the object is looked up in.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: Key of the object whose metadata is read.

properties.label: Version ID
properties.description: Reads the metadata of one specific version. Leave empty for the current version.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the object lives in.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: Key of the object the URL downloads.

properties.label: Version ID
properties.description: Signs a URL for one specific version. Leave empty for the current version.

properties.label: Expiration
properties.description: How long the URL stays valid, as an ISO-8601 duration: PT15M, PT1H, P1D. Must be positive and at most 7 days — that ceiling comes from the AWS SigV4 protocol, not from STACKIT, which documents no maximum of its own.

properties.label: Bucket
properties.description: Name of the bucket the upload is written to.

pattern.message: A bucket name must be 3-63 characters long, contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or digit. A FEEL expression (=myBucket) or a secret reference ({{secrets.MY_BUCKET}}) may be used instead.

properties.label: Object key
properties.description: Key the uploaded object is stored under.

properties.label: Content type
properties.description: Content type signed into the URL, for example application/pdf. Whoever uses the URL must send exactly this Content-Type header, or the signature will not match. Leave empty to let the uploader choose.

properties.label: Expiration
properties.description: How long the URL stays valid, as an ISO-8601 duration: PT15M, PT1H, P1D. Must be positive and at most 7 days — that ceiling comes from the AWS SigV4 protocol, not from STACKIT, which documents no maximum of its own.

properties.label: Version
properties.description: Version of the element template

properties.label: ID
properties.description: ID of the element template

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Result expression
properties.description: Expression to map the response into process variables. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Error expression
properties.description: Expression to handle errors. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Retries
properties.description: Number of retries

properties.label: Retry backoff
properties.description: ISO-8601 duration to wait between retries

properties.label: Job timeout
properties.description: ISO-8601 duration after which Zeebe considers this job timed out if not yet completed. Leave empty to use the default timeout

steps.name: Upload object
steps.description: Uploads a document to a bucket (PutObject). Streams the document, so objects up to the STACKIT limit of 5 TB are supported.

steps.name: Download object
steps.description: Downloads an object (GetObject) and returns it as a Camunda document, as text, or as parsed JSON.

steps.name: Delete object
steps.description: Deletes an object (DeleteObject). Succeeds even if the key does not exist, because S3 delete is idempotent.

steps.name: Copy object
steps.description: Copies an object server-side (CopyObject). The bytes stay inside STACKIT and never pass through the connector runtime.

steps.name: List objects
steps.description: Lists one page of objects in a bucket (ListObjectsV2). Returns a continuation token the process can loop on; the connector does not paginate by itself.

steps.name: Get object metadata
steps.description: Reads an object's metadata without downloading it (HeadObject). Returns exists: false instead of failing when the key is absent.

steps.name: Create presigned download URL
steps.description: Creates a time-limited URL that downloads an object without credentials. Computed locally, so nothing is sent to STACKIT and the object need not exist yet.

steps.name: Create presigned upload URL
steps.description: Creates a time-limited URL that uploads an object with HTTP PUT and no credentials. Computed locally, so nothing is sent to STACKIT.
